title: Translation and constant Jacobian minors of a strictly standard presentation
statement: Let $R$, $\Lambda$ and $A$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $\Lambda$ and $A$, and suppose $A$ is finitely presented over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $\pi\in R$ and $\alpha:A\to\Lambda$ be an $R$-algebra map. Suppose the image of $\pi$ is strictly standard in $A$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element]. Write $q_A$, $q_R$, and $q_\Lambda$ for quotient maps modulo the ideals generated by the respective images of $\pi^4$. Assume an $R$-algebra map $\rho:A/(\pi^4)\to R/(\pi^4)$ exists such that, for all $a\in A$ and $r\in R$, $\rho(q_A(a))=q_R(r)$ implies $q_\Lambda(\alpha(a))=q_\Lambda(r)$. Then there exist natural numbers $n,m,c$, an $R$-algebra presentation $P$ with $n$ generators and $m$ relations [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], $c\le\min(n,m)$, scalars $a_j,t\in R$ and $\lambda_i\in\Lambda$ such that: $\alpha(P.val_i)=\pi^4\lambda_i$; the constant coefficient of $P.relation_j$ is $\pi^4a_j$; $(1-\pi^3t)\pi$ belongs to the ideal generated by the maximal row minors of the $n\times c$ matrix with entry in row $i$, column $j$ equal to the constant coefficient of $\partial_i P.relation_j$ [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative]; and for every $j\ge c$, $P.\sigma(\pi)P.relation_j$ belongs to $(P.relation_k\mid k<c)+(P.relation_k\mid k<m)^2$. Here $P.\sigma$ is the presentation's polynomial lift, and the polynomial ring is as in [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring].

proof.text: Unpack the compatible quotient section. Apply exists_popescu_translated_presentation_data to obtain a presentation retaining its minor witness and ideal-square condition and whose generators are killed by that same section.

For each new generator, compatibility with alpha and the zero section value say its alpha-image has zero quotient class. Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and Ideal.mem_span_singleton produce lambda_i with alpha(P.val_i)=pi^4 lambda_i; choose the family.

Apply exists_popescu_translated_presentation_properties to the section, zero generator values and witnessed minor identity. It gives the relation constant coefficients and the constant-minor ideal membership.
Assemble n,m,c,P,hc,lambda,a,t and the four conclusions, retaining the ideal-square condition of the translated witness.

lean.statement: theorem exists_popescu_translated_presentation (R : Type u) (Λ : Type v) (A : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [CommRing A] [Algebra R Λ] [Algebra R A] [FinitePresentation R A] (π : R) (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) (hstandard : IsStrictlyStandardElement (R := R) (algebraMap R A π)) (hρ : ∃ ρ : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R A π) ^ 4}) →ₐ[R] (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 4}), ∀ (a : A) (r : R), ρ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ r → Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (α a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (algebraMap R Λ r)) : ∃ (n m c : ℕ) (P : Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m)) (hc : c ≤ min n m) (lam : Fin n → Λ) (a : Fin m → R) (t : R), (∀ i, α (P.val i) = algebraMap R Λ π ^ 4 * lam i) ∧ (∀ j, constantCoeff (P.relation j) = π ^ 4 * a j) ∧ (1 - π ^ 3 * t) * π ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin n) // I.card = c} ↦ (Matrix.submatrix (fun i j ↦ constantCoeff (pderiv i (P.relation (Fin.castLE (le_trans hc (min_le_right n m)) j)))) (I.val.orderEmbOfFin I.property) (fun j ↦ j)).det)) ∧ (∀ j : Fin m, c ≤ j.val → P.σ (algebraMap R A π) * P.relation j ∈ Ideal.span {f | ∃ k : Fin m, k.val < c ∧ f = P.relation k} + (Ideal.span (Set.range P.relation)) ^ 2)
